## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes in `client/`
- [ ] Drove the change in a real browser (not just the build)
- [ ] Respects theming (no hard-coded colors / dynamic Tailwind classes)
- [ ] Honors `prefers-reduced-motion` and keyboard navigation
- [ ] Microcopy reads premium (no "Submit" / "Processing")
- [ ] Updated docs / CHANGELOG if user-facing
